pages.title: Finding Midasium
pages.text: Default deposits: Nether, Y 32 to 127. Veins target up to 6 blocks, with 7 placement attempts per chunk. Mining requirement: level 4.

pages.title: Working Midasium
pages.text: Smelt Midasium Ore or Midasium Dust into ingots. Crushing the ore first normally yields two dusts. Ingots can be stored as metal blocks or converted into the material's other crafting forms.

pages.title: Default Tool Stats
pages.text: Durability: 89 uses.$(br)Harvest level: 4.$(br)Mining efficiency: 7.0.$(br)Material damage bonus: 2.6.$(br)Enchantability: 28.$(br2)These are the supplied material values. The item type, enchantments, and active traits affect final performance.

pages.title: Default Armor Stats
pages.text: Protection: helmet 4, chestplate 5, leggings 4, boots 4.$(br2)Toughness per piece: 2.0.$(br)Enchantability: 28.

pages.title: Hoe: Midas Touch
pages.text: Harvesting crops with this hoe will turn the crop drops into gold items (ingots, dusts and nuggets) instead.

pages.title: Weapon: Bounty
pages.text: Mobs occasionally drop extra loot, has a small chance to convert all drops into gold ingots.$(br2)$(br2)Bonus loot chance: §830% / 60% / 90% / 100%§7$(br2)Gold chance: §81% / 5% / 12% / 18%§7$(br2)§o(Scales with Looting enchantment)

pages.title: Tool: Greed
pages.text: Chance based fortune effect that stacks with the fortune enchantment. All drops have a small chance to be turned into gold ingots.
